title: Tracked slots are not selected
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, every source tape $i$, and every tracked component $r$ among data, visited marks, and origin marks, the partial selection of a physical call-layout index is undefined at the index assigned to component $r$ of tape $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$r$ is one of the three tracked components
replaced:
For every source tape $i$ and component $r$, the pair selection of the finalizer is
undefined at the physical index of component $r$ of bank $i$.
